Pharmacist Clinical Training Simulator

Cellulitis complicated by abscess - Vancomycin

教案設計者: 崇鈺老師研究室團隊 (Ya-Chi Chan, Shao-Yuan Hao)

Team: Group A

Class: Pharmacy 2024

👤 Case Background⌄
A 68-year-old male with a history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension. He is a farmer who makes a living by growing pineapples in Dashu District. On February 22, while working in the fields, he accidentally cut his calf with a sickle. Three days later, he developed fever, redness, swelling, and purulent discharge from the wound. He presented to our hospital on February 28 for further evaluation.
🧑‍⚕️ Patient Card⌄

68-year-old male with cellulitis complicated by abscess

  • 68 years old / Male / Farmer
  • Admission Date: Feb 28
  • Admission Reason: Cellulitis complicated by abscess and wound ulceration
  • Major Comorbidities: Diabetes mellitus, Hypertension
  • Occupation: Pineapple farmer
📋 Admission Note⌄

68-year-old male with a history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension.

He accidentally sustained a laceration on his left calf while working in the field on February 22. Three days later, fever, progressive redness, swelling, and purulent discharge developed around the wound.

He visited our hospital on February 28. Cellulitis complicated by abscess formation and wound ulceration was suspected. Surgical debridement was performed, and the patient was admitted to the intensive care unit for postoperative monitoring.

Clinical question: Is the current vancomycin exposure adequate? Should dose adjustment be recommended?

🎯 Learning Objectives⌄
  1. Evaluate empiric antibiotic therapy for severe cellulitis.
  2. Interpret MRSA culture reports.
  3. Calculate renal function and vancomycin dosing.
  4. Interpret vancomycin TDM results.
  5. Recommend appropriate vancomycin dose adjustment.
  6. Monitor treatment efficacy and safety.
